verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed a live llms.txt at developer.rippling.com (HTTP 200), and a second llms.txt exists at rippling.com. The developer llms.txt is written for agents, covering Bearer token auth, version pinning via the Rippling-Api-Version header, cursor pagination, a first authenticated call and npm SDK version checks. missing for 10: evidence that the agent docs cover IT-specific surfaces (devices, identity, inventory) rather than just the general platform API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent actually using the docs.
